title: Merge fold never consumes strokes under a new fill — brush Paint Normal (and any fill commit) leaves covered lines intact, unlike Flash 8
description:
FIXED. Merge fold now consumes strokes under a later-drawn fill (Flash 8 Paint Normal / plain-fill-commit semantics).

IMPLEMENTATION:
- Threaded a draw-order index (0=oldest, incoming last) onto stroke half-edges: InputEdge.drawOrder -> MutHalfEdge.drawOrder -> HalfEdge.drawOrder, carried through splitExistingEdge + coincident-edge merge (arrangement.ts, types.ts).
- build.ts consumeStrokesUnderFills(): after face-fill resolve, clears lineStyle of any stroke half-edge whose midpoint is covered by a fillRegion drawn STRICTLY LATER (region.order > he.drawOrder). Arrangement already splits the stroke at the fill boundary so covered span drops, uncovered ends survive. Clearing lineStyle also dissolves the now-covered seam.
- Opt-in: buildArrangementFromShapes({consumeStrokesUnderFills}) default FALSE (all other callers byte-identical). foldShapeIntoLayer/foldShapeIntoLayerCulled/planarMergeCommit take {preserveLines}; commitShapeToTimeline consumes; commitBrushStrokeToTimeline passes preserveLines:true for Fills/Behind/Selection/Inside modes.
- Strict draw-order keeps P2 line-splits-fill intact (line over fill has higher order -> survives).

TESTS: planar-merge.test.ts 'stroke-under-fill consumption (task 1430)' — 4 cases (repro: fill over middle of 100px line removes covered span keeps ends; reversed line-over-fill splits+survives; preserveLines keeps whole line; stroked-fill keeps own outline). failing-first then fix.
